## Orientation

Repo path (code only): `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--phase-reviewer`. Commit on `phase/phase-reviewer` excluding `.artifacts`. Do not edit `.artifacts/` or call `adaptive-artifacts`. Parallel wave mate owns `se_workflow/` and `tests/test_phase_reviewer.py` — you own `agents/` and `scripts/sync-plugin.sh` only.

Requirements:
R1: Ship `agents/se-reviewer.md` (or Cursor-equivalent) configured without Write/Edit tools; execute-phase invokes it once at phase end after the closing verification task and before merge (and before tier-2 when that phase exists).

Design Invariants:
- Reviewer writes no store records.
- Single writer remains the parent.
- `done` tasks are not reopened; gaps are new fix tasks.

Design Assumptions:
- Host supports tool restriction for the reviewer agent; if Cursor cannot match Claude Code `agents/`, the skill documents the fallback and still forbids writes in the prompt.
- retry-loop fix-task and budget machinery is available when this phase executes (ordinal after retry-loop).

Decisions:
- phase-reviewer-scope: Phase-end core reviewer; defer per-task review and pre-dispatch coverage check
- reviewer-inputs: Specs, acceptances, invariants, and phase diff only; no builder self-grades
